prompt_text: What is the best health insurance broker in Kansas City MO for someone who is self-employed?
answer_verbatim:
There isn’t one objectively “best” broker, but **BBS Insurance** looks like a strong first call for a self-employed Kansas City, MO resident. Its Kansas City page says it compares Missouri Marketplace plans, checks subsidy eligibility and doctors, and reports a 5.0 Google rating from 90 reviews. It’s based in North Kansas City. [BBS Insurance](https://bbs-insurance.com/service-areas/kansas-city/)

When you contact them, ask whether they’re currently certified to enroll Missouri Marketplace plans, which insurers they represent, and whether they’ll compare plans based on your doctors, prescriptions, and estimated annual income—not just the monthly premium. Brokers are generally paid by insurers, and some may not offer every carrier.

You can also compare brokers or find free, impartial enrollment help through [HealthCare.gov’s local-help directory](https://www.healthcare.gov/find-assistance/). If you want premium tax credits, make sure enrollment goes through the Marketplace.
